name: Örvar Smárason
about:
Örvar Smárason is an Icelandic writer and musician, and a founding member of the band múm.

His books include *Það sem við sjáum þegar við lokum augunum* and the short story collection *Svefngríman*. His writing has been published in French and Italian translation.
